name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v7.1.4: Concurrent-subagent degenerate-trace fix. No floor bump. Stage 1 — agent_id recovery: if SubagentStop delivers an empty agent_id (high fan-out via Task/Workflow tool), derive the work agent_id from the agent_transcript_path filename (agent-{uuid}.jsonl) BEFORE all state-file reads so task_session_id/retrieval_id are read from the correct per-agent file. Stage 2 — hygiene skip: if the trace is fully anchorless (no task_session_id, no retrieval_id, no applied_log_ids) AND prompt-less (user_prompt empty or == 'No user prompt found'), skip sending it — reap state, emit subagent_degenerate_skip telemetry, exit 0 cleanly. Precision: never skips a trace that has ANY anchor or a real prompt. agent_id_recovered field added to subagent_stop_keymap telemetry. v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. R2: unconditional task_session_id seed. R1: SubagentStop invariant monitor. v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0. Domain-shift bounded server-side via --top-k 8. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, Claude Code >= 2.1.163, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution — SubagentStart per-subagent search + per-TASK session_id. v7.0.0: ACE 1.5 / ace-cli 4.0.1 compatibility milestone. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
